references.text: The first census of the tribe of Naphtali counted 53,400 men, compared to 45,400 in this second census, showing a decrease in the size of the tribe.
Naphtali's sons are listed here: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem, who were the ancestors of the families counted in Numbers 26:48-50.
The birth of Naphtali is described here as the son of Jacob and Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant. This marks the origin of the tribe of Naphtali.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, which gives a prophetic description of the tribe's character and future.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Naphtali before entering Canaan, adding a prophetic dimension to the census.
